figures.title: GPT-2's 50,257-token vocabulary
figures.caption: GPT-2's vocabulary decomposes exactly into 256 base byte tokens, 50,000 learned merges, and one end-of-text marker. The rows are schematic because 256 and 1 would be invisible beside 50,000; the counts are exact.
figures.alt: Three rows: 256 base byte tokens, 50,000 learned merges, and one end-of-text marker. A bracket labels the total 50,257, and the arithmetic 256 + 50,000 + 1 = 50,257 is printed below.
